# PDF regression fixtures

`cms1500.pdf` is the public blank CMS-1500 SAMPLE downloaded from
https://www.cms.gov/medicare/cms-forms/cms-forms/downloads/CMS1500.pdf
on 2026-11-25. It contains no patient data. This is a printed, noninteractive
sample, not the user's medical claims PDF and not a submission-ready claim.
CMS warns that downloaded copies must not be used for claim submission:
https://www.cms.gov/medicare/billing/electronicbillingeditrans/1500

AcroForm, XFA, orphan-widget, read-only, multipage, and native-text fixtures
are generated synthetically by the tests. No private documents are included.
